# Marriott International

> > Marriott International's official website offering direct hotel bookings across 9,000+ properties in 30+ brands including The Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, W Hotels, and JW Marriott, with Marriott Bonvoy loyalty rewards.

Marriott.com serves as the primary booking platform for Marriott International's extensive portfolio of hotel brands, from luxury properties like The Luxury Collection to extended stay options. The site provides access to the Marriott Bonvoy loyalty program, vacation rentals through Homes & Villas, and internal portals for associates, suppliers, and franchisees via Marriott Global Source (MGS).

## Key Topics

- Marriott Bonvoy loyalty program
- The Ritz-Carlton
- St. Regis Hotels
- W Hotels
- JW Marriott
- The Luxury Collection
- Marriott Hotels brand
- Hotel booking and reservations
- Travel rewards and member benefits
- Homes & Villas by Marriott Bonvoy
- Edition Hotels
- Sheraton
- Best rate guarantee
- Global hotel locations
- Marriott Global Source (MGS) portal

## Hotel Booking & Reservations

- [Marriott Bonvoy Hotels | Book Directly & Get Exclusive Rates](https://www.marriott.com/default.mi): Homepage for booking 9000+ Marriott Bonvoy hotels with exclusive rates
- [Marriott | OUR BEST RATE. GUARANTEED](https://www.marriott.com/online-hotel-booking.mi): Best rate guarantee policy for direct Marriott bookings

## Hotel Brands & Portfolio

- [Marriott Brands | Marriott Bonvoy Hotel Brands](https://www.marriott.com/brands.mi): Portfolio of Marriott Bonvoy brands from luxury to extended stay hotels
- [Wonderful Hotels & Resorts | Marriott Hotels](https://marriott-hotels.marriott.com/): Marriott Hotels brand page showcasing hospitality and Bonvoy rewards

## Optional

- [Marriott Global Source (MGS)](https://mgs.marriott.com/): Internal portal for Marriott associates, suppliers, and franchisees
